newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunker prices flat steady, holday saps market.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunker prices flat steady, holday saps market.

text.p: ARA bunker prices were broadly steady on Friday and liquidity was poor as dealers looked forward to Christmas holidays.
Demand was slack for most regions except for in isolated pockets such as Algeciras.

Rotterdam prices for 380 cst bunker fuel was steady to firmer at $120-$121 ex-wharf, and Antwerp was assessed around a dollar higher than Rotterdam. Hamburg markets were very dull too, and prices were pegged around $3 above those in Rotterdam.
Most other markets saw little change in the price of bunker fuel, diesel or gas oil.
